rationale: The general Hilbert functor includes the open relative-divisor locus and its finite-flat zero-cycle specialization.

rationale: Effective relative zero cycles are represented by divided powers with arbitrary base change.

rationale: The divided-power space represents effective relative zero cycles.

rationale: The fppf sheafification definition divisor construction and the three reduction morphisms are explicit without conflating them with the historical restricted presheaf.

rationale: The stack retains line bundles and their isomorphisms while the Picard functor is the sheafification of fibrewise isomorphism classes.

label: Picard scheme
rationale: The classical relative construction and the corrected projective-field and proper-field existence theorems are explicit together with the boundary between schemes and algebraic spaces.

label: Positive Picard locus
rationale: The cohomologically positive Picard locus is open base-change compatible covered by positive divisors and its translates cover the Picard space.

label: Cartier divisor
rationale: Relative effective Cartier divisors and their moduli as an open Hilbert locus are developed directly.

label: Relative divisor functor
rationale: The relative effective Cartier divisor functor is represented by the open Cartier locus in the Hilbert functor.

label: Abel map

label: Projective bundle
